expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Eight included activities in seven days, and two of them are water parks. This is the family trip that earns its keep.
expert.tip: Pair the GWK park with Waterbom, they are fifteen minutes apart. Carry swimwear from the morning and the children will happily skip the statue photographs.

title: Grand Bali Family Holiday with Waterbom
alt: Waterbom park slides in Kuta, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to the safari park
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Villa resort in the valley west of Ubud town

activities.name: Kanto Lampo waterfall
activities.description: The wide stepped fan of Kanto Lampo, one of the easiest waterfalls in Bali to reach and the best for photographs with children.

activities.name: Bali Safari and Marine Park
activities.description: A safari ride through the African and Indian enclosures, the elephant and bird shows, and the water park on the same ticket.

activities.name: Central Bali with Tirta Empul
activities.match: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul
activities.description: The Bali swing, Tegenungan waterfall, the holy spring temple at Tirta Empul and a photo stop at the Tegalalang rice terraces.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights in a valley resort with a waterfall and safari day and a full day through the temples of central Bali.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Nusa Penida and Uluwatu
stops.hotel: Cross Vibe Paasha Atelier Bali Kuta
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Design hotel in Kuta with a rooftop pool

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast
activities.description: Speedboat across for the Paluang cliff viewpoint, Kelingking beach and the rock arch at Angel's Billabong, with Broken Bay after it.

activities.name: Balinese massage
activities.description: An hour of traditional Balinese massage after the island day, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a spa near the hotel.

activities.name: GWK cultural park
activities.description: Entry to the Garuda Wisnu Kencana park, with its giant statue, the amphitheatre and the dance performances through the afternoon.

activities.name: Waterbom Bali
activities.description: The best water park in Asia by most lists, with slides for every age, a lazy river and gardens to sit in between them.

activities.name: Water sports and Uluwatu with Kecak
activities.description: Parasailing, jet ski and a banana boat at Tanjung Benoa, then Uluwatu temple at sunset and the Kecak fire dance.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast with an island day, the GWK park, Waterbom and a south Bali day that ends with the Kecak dance.

day_titles.4: Nusa Penida and on to Kuta

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your valley resort near Ubud
Rest of the day free by the pool
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then on to Kanto Lampo waterfall
A full afternoon at Bali Safari and Marine Park
Safari ride, animal shows and the water park
Back at the resort in the evening
3: Breakfast, then a full day in central Bali
The Bali swing and Tegenungan waterfall
Tirta Empul, the holy spring temple
The Tegalalang rice terraces on the way back
4: Early breakfast and check out, then on to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
The Paluang cliff, Kelingking beach and Angel's Billabong
An hour of Balinese massage once you reach Kuta
5: Breakfast, then entry to the Garuda Wisnu Kencana park
The giant statue and the afternoon dance performances
The rest of the day at Waterbom Bali
Slides, the lazy river and the gardens
6: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Parasailing, jet ski and a banana boat with an instructor
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
Kecak fire dance in the amphitheatre afterwards
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

summary: Seven days for a family with three nights near Ubud for Kanto Lampo waterfall, Bali Safari and the temples of central Bali, then three in Kuta with Nusa Penida, the GWK park, Waterbom and the Kecak dance at Uluwatu.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kanto Lampo waterfall; Bali Safari and Marine Park; central Bali tour with Tirta Empul; Nusa Penida west coast tour; a Balinese massage; GWK park entry; Waterbom Bali tickets; water sports with Uluwatu and the Kecak dance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
